1: // Minimal Neon Runner game
2: // Targets <canvas id="game"></canvas>
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return;
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const W = (canvas.width = 800);
9:   const H = (canvas.height = 400);
10: 
11:   // Player
12:   const player = {
13:     w: 30,
14:     h: 30,
15:     x: 80,
16:     y: H - 30,
17:     vy: 0,
18:     onGround: true,
19:   };
20: 
21:   const GRAVITY = 0.8;
22:   const JUMP_STRENGTH = -15;
23:   const SLIDE_TIME = 30; // frames
24:   let slideCounter = 0;
25: 
26:   // Obstacles
27:   const obstacles = [];
28:   const OBSTACLE_SPACING = 200; // distance between obstacles
29:   let obstacleTimer = 0;
30: 
31:   let distance = 0;
32:   let gameOver = false;
33: 
34:   // Input
35:   const keys = {};
36:   window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
37:     if (e.code === 'Space') keys.jump = true;
38:     if (e.code === 'ArrowDown') keys.slide = true;
39:   });
40:   window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
41:     if (e.code === 'Space') keys.jump = false;
42:     if (e.code === 'ArrowDown') keys.slide = false;
43:   });
44: 
45:   function spawnObstacle() {
46:     // Randomly create a gap or low ceiling obstacle
47:     const type = Math.random() < 0.5 ? 'gap' : 'low';
48:     const height = type === 'low' ? 20 : 0; // low ceiling height
49:     obstacles.push({ x: W, y: H - height, w: 30, h: H - height, type });
50:   }
51: 
52:   function update() {
53:     if (gameOver) return;
54: 
55:     // Player physics
56:     if (keys.jump && player.onGround) {
57:       player.vy = JUMP_STRENGTH;
58:       player.onGround = false;
59:     }
60:     if (keys.slide && player.onGround) {
61:       slideCounter = SLIDE_TIME;
62:     }
63:     if (slideCounter > 0) {
64:       slideCounter--;
65:     }
66: 
67:     player.vy += GRAVITY;
68:     player.y += player.vy;
69:     if (player.y >= H - player.h) {
70:       player.y = H - player.h;
71:       player.vy = 0;
72:       player.onGround = true;
73:     }
74: 
75:     // Move obstacles
76:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
77:       const o = obstacles[i];
78:       o.x -= 5; // tunnel speed
79:       // Collision detection
80:       if (
81:         player.x < o.x + o.w &&
82:         player.x + player.w > o.x &&
83:         player.y < o.y &&
84:         player.y + player.h > o.y - o.h
85:       ) {
86:         gameOver = true;
87:       }
88:       // Remove off-screen
89:       if (o.x + o.w < 0) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
90:     }
91: 
92:     // Spawn logic
93:     obstacleTimer++;
94:     if (obstacleTimer > OBSTACLE_SPACING / 5) {
95:       spawnObstacle();
96:       obstacleTimer = 0;
97:     }
98: 
99:     distance += 5;
100:   }
101: 
102:   function draw() {
103:     // Background
104:     ctx.fillStyle = '#111';
105:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
106: 
107:     // Neon style
108:     ctx.strokeStyle = '#0ff';
109:     ctx.lineWidth = 2;
110: 
111:     // Draw player (neon square)
112:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0ff';
113:     const ph = slideCounter > 0 ? player.h / 2 : player.h;
114:     ctx.fillRect(player.x, player.y + (player.h - ph), player.w, ph);
115: 
116:     // Draw obstacles
117:     obstacles.forEach((o) => {
118:       if (o.type === 'low') {
119:         // low ceiling bar
120:         ctx.fillRect(o.x, 0, o.w, o.h);
121:       } else {
122:         // gap - nothing to draw, just space
123:       }
124:     });
125: 
126:     // Score
127:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0ff';
128:     ctx.font = '16px monospace';
129:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${Math.floor(distance / 10)}`, 10, 20);
130: 
131:     if (gameOver) {
132:       ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
133:       ctx.font = '30px monospace';
134:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', W / 2 - 80, H / 2);
135:     }
136:   }
137: 
138:   function loop() {
139:     update();
140:     draw();
141:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
142:   }
143: 
144:   // Start
145:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
146: })();
